name: Rejection Reason 14 Code
definition: Specifies the reason of a rejection of a movement cancellation request.

FAIL.name: Failed Validation
FAIL.definition: The validation of the advice/instruction/request failed.

INET.name: Invalid Event Type
INET.definition: CA Event Type does not correspond with the relating Corporate Action.

INUS.name: Invalid Underlying Security
INUS.definition: Underlying Security Identification does not correspond with the Corporate Action Reference supplied.

INPT.name: Invalid Event Processing Type
INPT.definition: Event Processing Type does not correspond with the relating Corporate Action.

INMV.name: Invalid Mandatory Voluntary Event Type
INMV.definition: Mandatory/Voluntary Event Type does not correspond with the relating Corporate Action.

INDE.name: Invalid Corporate Action Information
INDE.definition: Details specified in the Corporate Action General Information block are inconsistent with those that were specified in the relating original message.

INMO.name: Invalid Movement Information
INMO.definition: Details specified in the MOVEMENT GENERAL INFORMATION block are inconsistent with those that were specified in the relating original message.

SAID.name: Same Identification
SAID.definition: Several message with the same identification.

INID.name: Invalid Identification
INID.definition: Instruction contains an invalid message identification, identification is unknown.

MOSE.name: Movement Already Settled
MOSE.definition: One or more of the underlying movements have already settled.
